## Editable.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: Current value; bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the value changes (both live edits and commits).
- `onCommit` :: Called when an edit is committed via Enter or blur.
- `onCancel` :: Called when editing is cancelled via Escape or the cancel button.
- `placeholder` :: Placeholder displayed when empty.
- `activationMode` :: Gesture that enters edit mode: single click or double click.
- `submitMode` :: Events that commit the draft value.
- `withControls` :: Show explicit edit, confirm, and cancel icon buttons.
- `size` :: Control height and text scale on the shared size ladder.
- `gap` :: Space between the value and its confirm and cancel buttons on the shared gap ladder.
- `shape` :: Corner shape on the shared shape ladder.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the placeholder shown while the value is empty; muted by default so an empty field reads as unset.
- `disabled` :: Renders the value as plain text: neither the click gesture, the double-click gesture, nor the edit button opens the field.
- `invalid` :: Marks the value invalid.
- `saveButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the confirm IconButton shown with `withControls`.
- `cancelButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the cancel IconButton shown with `withControls`.
- `editButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the pencil IconButton that opens the field.
